200.description:
Read one Workday posting through the career site's CXS job API: title, requisition id, full description (text and HTML), primary and additional locations, country, time type, remote type, posting dates, apply URL and hiring entity.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `additional_locations` | string[] | Further locations of a multi-location posting; empty when there are none. |
| `apply_url` | string | The posting's Workday apply page. |
| `attribution` | string | Source attribution. |
| `can_apply` | boolean | Whether Workday accepts applications for the posting. |
| `career_site` | object | The Workday career site the call addressed, parsed from the input URL. |
| `country` | object | Country of the primary location; null when Workday omits it. |
| `description_html` | string | Full description HTML as Workday serves it. |
| `description_text` | string | Full description as plain text with line breaks. |
| `external_path` | string | Canonical posting path /job/{location}/{posting}. |
| `hiring_organization` | string | Hiring legal entity as Workday names it. |
| `job_posting_id` | string | Workday posting id (the last external_path segment). |
| `location` | string | Primary location. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | When the source was read (Unix ms). |
| `posted_date` | string | Posting start date (YYYY-MM-DD), Workday startDate. |
| `posted_on_text` | string | Relative posting text, e.g. 'Posted 30+ Days Ago'. |
| `posting_end_date` | string | Date the posting closes (YYYY-MM-DD), when the employer set one. |
| `remote_type` | string | Remote/hybrid/on-site label, when the site sets it. |
| `requisition_id` | string | Workday requisition id (jobReqId), e.g. JR2025114. |
| `time_left_to_apply` | string | Workday's countdown text, e.g. '14 days left to apply', when set. |
| `time_type` | string | Full time / Part time. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string | Canonical public posting URL as Workday reports it. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.description_html:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.

Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

Job Description:
This job is responsible for providing comprehensive advice and customized solutions to clients to help them achieve their financial goals. Key responsibilities include triaging client leads, making referrals to business partners based on client needs and asset thresholds, meeting with clients to review financial and investment goals, building a financial plan, and recommending brokerage products. Job expectations include applying and expanding knowledge by completing required licenses and trainings. This position is subject to SAFE Act registration requirements. Pursuant to the SAFE Act requirements, all employees engaged in residential loan mortgage originations must register with the federal registry system and remain in good standing. Since this position requires SAFE Act registration, employees are required to register and to submit to the required SAFE Act background check and registration process. Failure to obtain and/or maintain SAFE Act registration may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.

Responsibilities:

  • Works with clients to plan their short and long-term financial goals by building a financial plan with brokerage products, including stocks, bonds, mutual funds, annuities, and banking and money managed solutions
  • Recommends banking and investments strategies that align with client financial goals and needs
  • Triages client requests and makes referrals to appropriate internal service providers based on client needs and asset thresholds
  • Mitigates and controls risk as part of daily activities
  • Identifies and engages potential new clients through referrals or financial center clientele
  • Provides coaching and feedback to referral partners based on knowledge of client needs and potential product services recommended

Skills:

  • Account Management
  • Advisory
  • Client Experience Branding
  • Customer and Client Focus
  • Oral Communications
  • Active Listening
  • Attention to Detail
  • Client Solutions Advisory
  • Issue Management
  • Pipeline Management
  • Causation Analysis
  • Client Management
  • Policies, Procedures, and Guidelines
  • Risk Management
  • Written Communications

Minimum Education Requirement: High School Diploma / GED / Secondary School or equivalent

Shift:

1st shift (United States of America)

Hours Per Week: 

40

Pay Transparency details

US - WA - Mercer Island - 2830 80th Ave Se - MERCER ISLAND BC (WA3143)

Pay and benefits information

Pay range

$70,000.00 - $80,000.00 annualized salary, offers to be determined based on experience, education and skill set.

Formulaic incentive eligible

This role is eligible to participate in a formulaic incentive plan. Employees are eligible for incentives as detailed by the specific line of business incentive plan provisions. Formulaic plans may be comprised of monthly, quarterly and/or annual incentive opportunities. Incentives are earned based on the employee’s performance against defined metrics.

Benefits

This role is currently benefits eligible. We provide industry-leading benefits, access to paid time off, resources and support to our employees so they can make a genuine impact and contribute to the sustainable growth of our business and the communities we serve.

post.description:
Start here with any Workday career-site URL. Read `facets` to filter by location, job category, time type or remote type (parameters differ per employer), page with next_offset, then call get_job with a result's external_path or url for the full description.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

career_site.description: Any URL of a Workday career site: https://{tenant}.wd{N}.myworkdayjobs.com/{site} (an /en-US/-style locale segment, a search-results URL with ?q= and facet parameters, or a posting URL are fine) or https://wd{N}.myworkdaysite.com/recruiting/{tenant}/{site}.

facets.description: Filters as Workday exposes them: each {parameter, ids} uses a facet parameter and value ids from a previous search_jobs `facets`. Values within one parameter are ORed, parameters are ANDed. When omitted, facet parameters in a pasted search-results URL apply.

limit.description:
Results per page; Workday serves at most 20.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 20; default 20.

offset.description:
Result offset: 0 for the first page, then the previous page's next_offset. Workday serves only the first 2000 results of a query.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 1999; default 0.

query.description: Keyword search over the site's postings (Workday searchText). Omit to list everything. When omitted, a pasted URL's ?q= applies.

200.description:
Search one Workday career site's open requisitions through its CXS jobs API: keyword plus the site's own facet filters, 1-20 results per page with offset pagination, the total, and every facet the site offers with value ids and counts.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `jobs` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bullet_fields` | string[] | The extra list fields the site configures, usually the requisition id; may be empty. |
| `external_path` | string | Workday posting path /job/{location}/{posting}; pass it with career_site to get_job. |
| `job_posting_id` | string | Workday posting id: the last segment of external_path, e.g. Senior-Engineer_JR2025114. |
| `locations_text` | string | Location as listed, e.g. 'US, CA, Santa Clara' or '4 Locations'; null when the site's list omits it. |
| `posted_on_text` | string | Relative posting text as Workday renders it, e.g. 'Posted Today', 'Posted 30+ Days Ago'. |
| `remote_type` | string | Remote/hybrid/on-site label, when the site lists it. |
| `time_type` | string | Full time / Part time, when the site lists it. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string | Public posting page. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
